standard.summary: 分析哪些交换层适合缓存或复用，减少重复传输。
standard.effect: observe 只给建议，cache_v0 会在预算内缓存部分解码副本。
standard.whenToUse: prefetch 覆盖差、PCIe 等待明显、同一冻结层频繁重复上 GPU 时尝试。
standard.avoidWhen: 显存已经很紧、prefetch 已经完整覆盖，或没有明显 PCIe 等待时不要开启 cache_v0。

standard_en.summary: Analyses which swapped layers are worth caching or reusing, to cut repeated transfers.
standard_en.effect: observe only advises; cache_v0 caches some decoded copies within a budget.
standard_en.whenToUse: Worth trying when prefetch coverage is poor, PCIe waiting is visible, and the same frozen layer keeps going onto the GPU again and again.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Do not turn cache_v0 on when VRAM is already tight, when prefetch covers everything, or when there is no obvious PCIe waiting.

advanced.principle: 冻结权重在训练中不变，部分层的 GPU 解码结果可以跨 step 复用；候选分析先估算收益和显存预算。
advanced.intervention: observe 只读运行记录；cache_v0 介入 GPU 侧缓存，不改变训练目标。
advanced.expectedImpact: 可能减少重复传输和解码；收益取决于缓存命中、预算大小和当前 offload 图。
advanced.tradeoffs: 缓存会占用额外 VRAM。自动智能感知默认只建议，不自动分配缓存。

advanced_en.principle: Frozen weights do not change during training, so some layers' GPU decode results can be reused across steps; a candidate analysis first estimates benefit and VRAM budget.
advanced_en.intervention: observe is a read-only recording run; cache_v0 intervenes with GPU-side caching without changing the training objective.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: May reduce repeated transfers and decoding; the benefit depends on cache hit rate, budget size, and the current offload graph.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: Caching consumes extra VRAM. The auto smart-sense mode only suggests by default; it does not allocate cache automatically.
